basic_profile.bio: Avid music lover with a passion for bedroom pop and a fascination with the aesthetics of steampunk. Based in Portland, Oregon, I work as a freelance graphic designer. I enjoy creating visually captivating designs and blending modern elements with vintage styles. I'm usually online in the evenings, diving into Reddit after a day of creative work. Single and enjoying the freedom to explore various interests, from collecting vintage gears to discovering new music artists.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in graphic design and have spent years honing my skills through freelance projects and personal artistic endeavors. My love for music and design has led me to explore different subcultures, including the unique blend of bedroom pop and steampunk aesthetics.
